content: {"question":"What advantage does focusing on quantification provide when preparing a promotion case for a GitLab team member?","answer":"It makes the case easier to build over time and allows the author to gauge progress at any point.","evidence":"The emphasis on quantification over editorialization has a number of benefits for both the reader and the author:\n- It's easier to gradually assemble the document over time, and to understand the level of completion at any point."}
